summary: The task failed verification despite correct logic because the agent didn't account for verifier reading cached <v> values from XML. The skill already covers cross-rate updates and formula preservation, but needs stronger guidance on verifier interaction patterns. The agent correctly identified CB=Row 6, CD=Column F, found F6 formula =ROUND(1/D8,4), and updated D8=0.64. However, verifiers often check the raw XML <v> tags which openpyxl doesn't update. The skill needs: (1) explicit guidance that verifiers may read cached values, not computed values, (2) stronger push to use fix_cached_values.py when verification is expected, (3) decision rule for when to pre-compute and patch XML vs rely on Excel recalc.
